text: ok. it is not being edited anymore. the glass still hasnt landed as far as i can see either, erm. nevermind. it did inside of the standalone launcher but not the compiled route. whats different ?
resolution: Diagnosis (no code change): glass renders in the standalone 'rjit game play' but not the editor /compiled route. Traced both paths — scene3d.render is identical (it records the scene to an offscreen RT; the real opaque+transparent drawScene runs in flushPending from gpu.frame), so the transparent glass pass is the same code in both. The structural difference: standalone builds world_loader as its OWN binary fresh each run, while /compiled renders world_loader COMPILED INTO the dev host (v8_app @import world_loader.zig, dispatched via renderEmbedded). framework/world_loader.zig changes do NOT hot-reload, so a running rjit dev host still embeds the OLD world_loader (no translucent emission → tcount 0 → no glass) while rjit game play rebuilt with the new code. Both read the same gamefile (glass materials are baked in). Fix: rebuild/restart the dev host. Awaiting the user's rebuild test — if glass still differs after a clean dev-host rebuild, there is a genuine embedded-vs-standalone drawScene difference to chase.
